title: Half Way Along, The Meter Almost Reads The pKa
summary: Add base to a weak acid and two landmarks appear for free: the pKa half way to equivalence, and an equivalence point that is never at pH 7. Both are shortcuts, and the page shows exactly where each one breaks.

sources.title: Harris, Quantitative Chemical Analysis, 9th edition, chapters 9 to 11
de Levie, The formalism of titration theory, Chemical Educator 6 (2001) 272-276
